    AsyncModelInferenceFunction(InferenceConfig inferenceConfig, Function<InferenceConfig,InferenceEngine<?>> engineFactory)
    Constructs async inference function with the default executor pool size (32 threads — tune via AsyncModelInferenceFunction(InferenceConfig, Function, int) to match the capacity you pass to AsyncDataStream.unorderedWait(...); they should generally be the same order of magnitude, since capacity governs how many in-flight asyncInvoke calls Flink allows per subtask).
